title: A tree with Rc, Weak and RefCell
description:
Build a tree of named nodes where children are owned with `Rc` and each node keeps a `Weak` reference to its parent:

```rust
struct Node {
    name: String,
    parent: RefCell<Weak<Node>>,
    children: RefCell<Vec<Rc<Node>>>,
}

fn node(name: &str) -> Rc<Node>
fn add_child(parent: &Rc<Node>, child: &Rc<Node>)        // also sets the child's parent
fn path(node: &Rc<Node>) -> String                      // "root/docs/notes.txt"
fn depth(node: &Rc<Node>) -> usize                      // 0 for a node without a parent
fn count(node: &Rc<Node>) -> usize                      // the node and everything below it
fn find(node: &Rc<Node>, name: &str) -> Option<Rc<Node>>  // depth-first, children in insertion order
fn detach(child: &Rc<Node>)                             // removes it from its parent's children
```

Because parents are `Weak`, dropping the root frees the whole tree; a child that is detached gets no parent.
hints: `Rc::downgrade(&parent)` makes a `Weak` that does not keep the parent alive; `weak.upgrade()` returns `Some(Rc)` only while the parent still exists.
The `RefCell`s let you change a node's parent and children through a shared `Rc`: `node.children.borrow_mut().push(...)`. `Rc::ptr_eq` tells whether two `Rc`s point to the same node.
